name: io.github.fxia0018/furima-mcp
title: Furima
description: Search Mercari, Yahoo! Auctions, Yahoo! Flea Market and Rakuma, and check prices against sold data.

environmentVariables.name: FURIMA_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds between requests to the same site (default 1.0)

environmentVariables.name: FURIMA_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to reuse identical search results; 0 disables the cache (default 300)
